scope: Actual PowerShell selection/serialization functions with controlled OS/Docker fixtures, plus compiled native HTTP parser; no native Windows probes, Docker connection or workload.

checks.name: Reject ambiguous process roots and unsafe Docker/path scope
Exact identity tree excludes foreign and historical-parent children
Known children survive parent exit; reused child does not inherit CPU deltas
Missing process memory and I/O remain null; deltas require same identity
Root mismatch fails before creating output or reading Docker
Host CPU uses deltas; unavailable disk and memory are not invented
Docker reads only exact owned image and exports selected metrics
Missing Docker scope makes no call; budget exhaustion is explicit
Native HTTP parser handles bounded JSON and rejects error/truncation
